title: Handle unfamiliar questions
text: What do you do when you do not know an answer?

options.text: I say I do not know and stop without further discussion.
options.response: 提到了部分处理方式，但解释还不完整。

options.text: I state what I understand, identify the missing part and explain how I would investigate it.
options.response: 回答说明了关键条件和处理方法。

options.text: I give a confident answer even if I am unsure.
options.response: 这一说法忽略了关键条件，需要重新分析。
